EN: I didn't realize he already had a home! You're one lucky owner. Here he is! Bigsby! You can come out now!
ZH: 我都不知道它已经有了一个家！你真是个幸运的主人。比格斯比在这里！你现在可以出来了。

EN: I rescued the salvage team, but Bigsby wasn't with them. One said they may have taken shelter in Vault 314.
ZH: 我救下了救援队。但比格斯比没有和他们在一起。有人说他们可能去了314号避难所。

EN: Railroad agents managed to evade capture and headed for one of their safehouses. Check in with them and make sure they're all right.
ZH: 铁路特工成功躲避了抓捕，前往了某个藏身处。和他们确认一下是否都还安全。

EN: Name's Maximus. Uh, I'm not really supposed to be in here. If we could keep this between us, I'd appreciate it.
ZH: 我叫马克西姆斯。呃，我其实不应该在这儿，你可别告诉别人啊。

EN: The brotherhood has a pretty large base set up nearby. As quasi-religious orders of militants go, they're generally not awful. Maybe we should stop in and say hello.
ZH: 附近有个钢铁兄弟会的基地，虽然他们是带有宗教色彩的军事组织，但总体来说还算不错。或许我们可以去打个招呼。

EN: A group known as “The Railroad” was trying to sneak refugees through the area, when they were captured by Raiders. Find and rescue them before it's too late.
ZH: 一群称作是“铁路”的人试图将难民偷偷送走，结果被掠夺者们发现并抓走了。请尽快找到他们。

EN: Sierra Petrovita has been trapped by Ghouls at the local Super-Duper Mart. Rescue her before they make her their next meal.
ZH: 茜拉佩罗维塔被尸鬼们困在了当地的大无敌超市。在她变成它们下一顿饭之前赶紧救她出来。

EN: Despite the best efforts of the Vault 144 Dwellers, we discovered the location of their home and that they only worship Death because “Death” was incorrectly capitalized in their Vault's instruction manual! We must now infiltrate Vault 144 and stop them from waking Death...
ZH: 尽管144号避难所的居民费尽心力，我们还是发现了他们避难所的位置，他们只崇拜“死亡”，是因为避难所指导手册里“death”被错误地首字母大写了！我们现在必须渗透进入144号避难所，阻止他们唤醒“死亡”……

EN: Can it be true? Has someone figured out a way to create water so powerful it can heal any ill, boost any crop, and fix any door? The people at Vault 315 should know more!
ZH: 这是真的吗？有人想出了一个方法来创造如此强大的水，它可以治愈任何疾病，提高作物产量，并修好门？315号避难所的人应该知道更多！

EN: For too long, the evil bandit Eli Calvert has raided the innocent Dwellers of the Wasteland. For the safety of your Vault, assemble your soldiers and rain death upon Eli and his gang of madmen!
ZH: 很长一段时间，恶毒的土匪依莱·卡尔弗特总是喜欢欺负无辜的居民。为了避难所的安全，召集你的战士们给依莱和他的疯子帮派下死亡通知书吧！

EN: Overseer Patel's journal indicated Paula Plumbkin had gone to Vault 909, but that it had already been overrun! Hopefully she's okay...
ZH: 监督者帕特尔的日志上显示宝拉·普朗布金去了909号避难所。但那里貌似被侵占了，希望她还好。

EN: There's no sense toying around with Raiders when we can just crush them! Send a group loaded with Power Armor out to a local Raider camp and deal with their Boss.
ZH: 没必要和掠夺者们周旋，直接干掉他们就行了！派遣一队穿着动力装甲的居民前往当地的掠夺者营地，和他们的首领较量一番吧。

EN: The Horseman, War, has invited us to discuss matters of common interest. His messenger told us the Warshippers would try to kill us, but it's worth the risk to find out what he wants! Also, we should be on the lookout for Weekly Exposition reporters, and use the codeword “eagle” after they talk about Nuka-Cola.
ZH: 骑士“战争”，已经邀请我们讨论共同感兴趣的事情。他的信使告诉我们战争崇拜者会杀了我们，但值得冒这个风险！同时，我们应该留心每周博览会记者，在他们谈论核子可乐后使用暗号“鹰”。

EN: One of your Dwellers came aross an old cabin in the Wasteland. Sounds like somebody's having a party.
ZH: 一位居民发现了一间小屋。听起来像是有人在开派对。

EN: The Feral Ghouls from the old Nuka-Cola plant dragged Paula Plumbkin to an abandoned building. She needs rescuing!
ZH: 旧核子可乐工厂里的狂尸鬼把宝拉拖到了一处废弃建筑里。得去救她。

EN: Mole rats have infested a Super-Duper Mart nearby. The location is a vital source of supplies for travelers. Kill the brood mother to make the location safe once again.
ZH: 附近的大无敌超市鼹鼠已经泛滥成灾。这地方是给旅行者提供物资的重要地点。除掉鼹鼠妈妈，让这个地方回归正常。

EN: Watch out! While exploring near a Red Rocket fuel station, one of your Wasteland explorers has stumbled across a nest of radroaches! Ewww!
ZH: 小心！在红火箭服务站附近探索时，你的一位废土探险者撞上了一窝辐射蟑螂！呃……

EN: I found out from the Ghouls living in the Poseidon Energy offices that Bottle & Cappy may have been taken to the RobCo Building. Looks like that's my next stop.
ZH: 我从住在海神能源办公室的尸鬼那里得知，瓶瓶和盖盖可能被带到了罗伯科大楼。看来那里是我的下一站了。

EN: Maybe Coach is rummaging around the ruins of the old sports bar, Nick Nack Quarterback's. If he is, that Jersey's as good as ours!
ZH: 也许教练在旧的运动酒吧废墟里四处搜寻。如果他在“小摆设四分卫”那家店的话，棒球衫一定是我们的了！

EN: Woah! What's that? This festive waterfront has suffered a ruinous fate in some kind of ill-founded fracas! Get in there and dig around, who knows what you'll find!?
ZH: 哇哦！这是什么？这个曾经热闹的海滨现在变成了废墟，好像发生了什么可怕的事！进去看看吧，说不定能找到点好东西！

EN: Opportunity knocks! One of your Wasteland explorers has discovered a Red Rocket fuel station that looks uninhabited. There might be something useful inside.
ZH: 机会来敲门！你的一位废土勇士发现了一个尚未被占领的红火箭服务站。里面可能有些有用的东西。

EN: A band of well-armed raiders attacked a caravan a few days back and made off with a number of settlers, we're assuming to use as slaves. We've got their last known co-ordinates and direction of travel, but no one was able to track them. We should send some good people out to track down and free the abductees, and eliminate these slavers. They're the last thing we need lurking around in our back yard.
ZH: 几天前，一群全副武装的掠夺者袭击了一个商队，还带走了几名定居者，估计是打算把他们当作奴隶。虽然知道他们最后出现的地点和移动方向，但没人能找到他们的行踪。我们得派些可靠的人去解救被绑架的定居者，顺便消灭这些奴隶贩子。可不能再让这帮掠夺者在我们的地盘上欺行霸市。

EN: We found a Rackie Jobinson baseball card with a taunting note from Coach. Looks like he really does have the Jersey. But we'll never give up!
ZH: 我们发现了教练留下的罗基·杰宾森的棒球卡和嘲笑我们的信息。看起来棒球衫似乎真的在他手上。我们绝不会放弃的！

EN: The Raider Boss at Vault 177 boasted that they took Bottle & Cappy to the Poseidon Energy offices. I hope she was telling the truth.
ZH: 177号避难所的掠夺者首领吹嘘他们把瓶瓶和盖盖带去了海神能源办公室。但愿她讲的是真话。

EN: According to a page from Paula Plumbkin's journal, Vault 525 really is Vaultopolis, but even she doesn't know where it is. But the Mayor's office may hold that information!
ZH: 根据宝拉·普朗布金日志里所说的，525号避难所确实是个避难所大都会，但她也不知道在哪里。也许市长办公室里会有相关的信息。

EN: One of your Dwellers stumbled across a Super Duper Mart while out in the Wasteland. Perhaps you'll find something useful inside...
ZH: 一位居民在废土探险时发现了一处大无敌超市。也许应该进去看看有没有什么有用的东西……

EN: The Radscorpion's creepy keeper said Paula Plumbkin went to the nuclear power plant, so that's where we'll look for her.
ZH: 辐射蝎的诡异饲养者说宝拉·普朗布金去了核电站，我们决定去那里找她。

EN: A disgruntled Dweller named Rubarb has joined the Raiders and wants to liberate some local Vaults... with violence! Overseer Mogabe needs your help!
ZH: 一个叫鲁巴布的居民牢骚满腹，他加入了掠夺者的队伍，想要……用暴力“解放”当地的避难所！监督者莫加比需要你的帮助！

EN: A neighboring Vault has had a massive radiation leak and the citizens have turned into Feral Ghouls!
ZH: 我们的邻近的避难所发生了大型的辐射泄漏，居民们变成了狂尸鬼！

EN: A distress call has come in from a nearby science lab studying Radroaches. Thieves stole their Radiation Suits and released all the Radroaches to cover their escape. Now the scientists are in over their heads and asking for help!
ZH: 一个求救电话从附近的一个研究辐射蟑螂的科学实验室传来。小偷偷走了他们的防辐射服并释放了所有的辐射蟑螂来辅助他们逃跑。现在科学家们束手无策，正在求救！

EN: Nothing, he left before we could catch him. Said some settlers were stuck in a Mole rat den. But enough talk, now you die!
ZH: 没怎么，在我们能抓到他之前就离开了。说是一些定居点的人被困在了鼹鼠洞穴里。话说完了，准备受死吧！

EN: The path has led you to the home of Road Rash and his gang of Raiders! Find out if they know anything.
ZH: 这条路会带你到“道路丘疹”和他的掠夺者团伙的据点！去看看他们是不是知道点什么。

EN: A group of Raiders is holding a rowdy shindig while their Boss is away. Now's our chance to infiltrate them while they're partying. If we can turn them against their Boss, the whole gang will be destroyed from within!
ZH: 一群掠夺者趁着他们的老大不在，偷偷开了一个疯狂而盛大的舞会。现在是我们渗透到他们内部的好机会。如果我们能离间他们和他们的老板，整个帮派就会从内部瓦解掉！

EN: No sign of Coach at the cereral processing plant. Maybe he's scavenging for electronics at the old General Atomics factory? Worth a looksie...
ZH: 没在麦片加工厂看到教练。也许他去旧的通用原子厂寻找电子元件了？值得看一看。

EN: Death wasn't in Vault 144. He's in a cave somewhere, and Vault 144 Dwellers are still out there trying to wake him up. It's time to meet back up with War to give him a status report! And while we're at it, we can keep the Warshippers out of trouble by asking them to find the cave...
ZH: 死亡不在144号避难所。他在某处的一个山洞里，144号避难所居民仍在试图叫醒他。是时候回头和“战争”碰头，交上状态报告了！既然顺路，我们也让“战争崇拜者”们去找那个洞穴，免得他们惹麻烦……

EN: You've received a distress call from a settlement! They're willing to leave and join your Vault if you save them.
ZH: 你收到了来自定居点的求救信号！只要你去救他们，他们就愿意离开家园、加入你的避难所。

EN: While we were spreading Christmas cheer, someone managed to track down Santa Claus. He's in trouble. Let's go!
ZH: 当我们四处散播圣诞节日气氛时，有人找到了圣诞老人。他遇到了麻烦。我们走！

EN: A swarm of malfunctioning security robots has taken over some ruins downtown. If they dig in there, they could be a threat to us and other survivors. Get some guns, go in there, and clear them out. Don't underestimate them, they may be slow and simple minded but they are relentless, and heavily armed.
ZH: 一群失控的安保机器人占领了市中心的一些废墟。如果他们在那里扎根，可能会对我们和其他幸存者构成威胁。带上武器进去，把它们清理干净。不要低估它们，它们虽然行动缓慢，头脑简单，但它们毫不留情，而且装备精良。

EN: Ok, but it might be more help if you opened up to trading with the traders, instead of robbing them blind.
ZH: 好吧，但如果你能与商队贸易，而不是直接抢劫他们，可能效果会更好。

EN: Sure, Robots are great! Well, the peaceful ones. We just want you to stop attacking traders. We can all share with each other.
ZH: 当然，机器人很棒！嗯，我是指那些和平的机器人。我们只是希望你不要再攻击商队了。我们可以互相分享。

EN: Hmm. Yes! Robots have plenty to share! Tell the merchants they will have no further trouble from Robot Hood!
ZH: 嗯，确实！机器人有很多东西可以分享！告诉商人，机器人罗宾汉不会再找他们的麻烦了！

EN: We have recently made contact with some Traders who say they were waylayed on the road by a mysterious bandit. They claim the thief was shouting something about fighting human oppression, and made off with a significant portion of the Traders' goods. We need you to go out there and track this bandit down. See if they can be reasoned with, and deal with them otherwise. We need to keep the trade routes safe and clear!
ZH: 我们最近与一些商人取得了联系，他们说在路上被一个神秘的强盗袭击了。他们声称这个强盗高喊着反抗人类压迫的口号，并抢走了商队的大部分货物。我们需要你去找到这个强盗，看看能不能和他讲道理，否则就解决他。我们需要保持贸易路线的安全和畅通！

EN: Let's see how you fare against a nest full of Radscorpions. Oh, and this time, you can only have two people in your squad.
ZH: 让我们来看看你想怎么对付一窝辐射蝎。但这次，你的小队里只能有两个人。

EN: Rubarb and his Raiders just took over Vault 711, and he's still there. Take down his lieutenants, then confront Rubarb himself!
ZH: 鲁巴布和他的掠夺者们占领了711号避难所，他还在那儿。拿下他的手下，然后亲自和他对峙！

EN: All this time, Three Dog has been saving lives, helping Settlers evade the Horsemen's followers, but it's put him on Vault 144's hit list! His last broadcast has him on the run from Death cultists. We need to get to him before they do, and one of his pursuers might know the location of Death's cave!
ZH: 在这段时间里，三狗一直在救人，帮助定居者躲避骑士的追随者，但也导致他被列入144号避难所的暗杀名单！他的最后一次广播让他被“死亡”的信徒追杀。我们必须在这些信徒之前找到他，其中一个追杀者可能知道“死亡”之穴的位置！

EN: Coach left a taunting message spray painted on the wall of the Lakeville Library! We're closing in! Time to search the ruins of Vault 789.
ZH: 教练在莱克维尔图书馆的墙上喷了一条嘲讽的留言！我们快追上了！该去789号避难所的废墟搜一搜了。

EN: Rumor has it Area 51 is packed with tech that could benefit our vault. It's bound to be heavily guarded: we better stock up on medical supplies.
ZH: 据说51区里满是对我们避难所有价值的技术。那里肯定戒备森严：最好先备齐医疗物资。

EN: Thanks to our contacts, we're confident we can convince the Brotherhood of Steel to sign off on gear we'll use to raid their own facilities. Ah! The irony!
ZH: 有了联系人的帮助，我们有信心说服钢铁兄弟会签署一份申领表，让我们用他们自己的装备来进行突袭。啊！真是讽刺！

EN: With requisition forms in hand, we're headed to the Brotherhood depot for top-tier gear. How hard can it be?
ZH: 申领表在手，我们去兄弟会仓库领取一流装备。能有多难？

EN: Go meet the quartermaster B38. Up a floor, second left, then down, retrace your steps, up again... maybe.
ZH: 去找军需官B38。上一层，左转第二个，然后下去，原路返回，再上去……也许。

EN: Hmm... It isn't on my list of valid reasons. I'll have to deny access using strong language and stronger weapons.
ZH: 嗯……这不在我有效理由清单上。我得用强硬言辞和更强硬的武器拒绝入内。

EN: Oh! This is gear-related. I handle plushies. But hey, you look like you need a hug. Here's a teddy bear.
ZH: 哦！这归装备口管，我管毛绒玩具。不过你看着挺需要个拥抱的——给，泰迪熊一只。

EN: Hey, visitors! Sit down and talk with me. Have you ever asked yourself: is being a scribe a good position?
ZH: 嘿，访客！坐下聊聊。你有没有问过自己：当抄写员到底是不是个好差事？

EN: I understand how the constant pressure of time can lead the mind away from the satisfaction of indulging in... hey, where are you going?
ZH: 我理解，时间的持续压迫会让人无法沉浸在……的满足之中……嘿，你们去哪儿？

EN: Being a scribe is first and foremost devoting oneself to the pursuit of knowledge! Scribes are the living memory... Oh, hey, you feel asleep there.
ZH: 做抄写员首先是要全身心追求知识！抄写员是活着的记忆……哦，嘿，你在那里睡着了。

EN: With gear and meds ready, we are set for our heist. Something feels wrong, though. We might not be facing the enemy we expected!
ZH: 装备和医疗物资就位，一切准备就绪。不过感觉有什么不对。我们面对的敌人可能不是预期的那个！

EN: Despite our success, more rogue Securitrons swarm the Mojave region. The RobCo factory might hold answers.
ZH: 尽管我们取得了成功，更多流氓保安机器人在莫哈维地区肆虐。罗伯科工厂或许能找到答案。

EN: We heard a distress call from "sane" Securitrons holed up in a vault. Maybe they can shed light on the combat inhibitor issue.
ZH: 我们接到了一群躲在避难所里的“神志清醒”的保安机器人发出的求救信号。也许它们能解释战斗抑制器的问题。

EN: Help, citizen. You heard our distress call. Our combat inhibitors are compromised. Failure imminent!
ZH: 市民，求你帮忙。你听到了我们的求救信号。我们的战斗抑制器已被破坏，随时会失效！

EN: The rogue Securitrons trace back to a warehouse near the Sarsaprilla bottling plant. Find whoever's responsible.
ZH: 流氓保安机器人的源头追查到了沙士装瓶工厂附近的一座仓库。找出是谁干的。
